attempts.summary: Configured 512MB compressed (lzo) zram swap on node1 via a custom systemd oneshot unit (zram-swap.service), enabled at boot, with priority 100 so it is preferred over the existing disk-backed swap (/dev/vda2, priority -2). Verified persistence by restarting node1 and confirming boot identity changed and zram swap auto-activated post-restart. RHEL 7.9 has no zram-generator package (that's a RHEL8+/9 tool), so swap was built manually from the in-tree zram kernel module.
